body.p: After , . Owns new src/format.c, src/format_internal.h, src/function_library_format.c, tests/format_test.c. One picture engine for numbers that XSLT's xsl:number and xsl:decimal-format reuse (4.10): format-integer (all primary tokens, ordinals in English, grouping, ^radix), format-number with decimal formats from the static context (2.2), exponent separator, %:pc forms. Pictures are scanned by hand (). Done when fn-format-integer and fn-format-number ≥ 95%. Spec: F&O 4.0 "Formatting integers", "Formatting numbers". Done 2026-10-17 (): src/format.c engine, part format; fn-format-integer 87/87 run, fn-format-number 252/286 run (88%): 33 of the 34 failures need the static context's decimal formats in the evaluator (Proposed), the other expects Java's digits of 4.9e-324.
